snippet.title: Silver Pines | Release Date and Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
"Here for the show? I wouldn't want to miss this for the world."

Private investigator Red Walker finds himself in the mysterious town of Silver Pines, a place that feels like its on the edge of a dream and the waking world. Untangle the mysteries of the town, encounter nightmarish creatures, and solve the riddle of the missing musician, Eddie Velvet.

*Silver Pines is a new survival horror releasing on October 8th 2026 on PC and consoles.*

*Play the Silver Pines Demo now on Steam:* https://store.steampowered.com/app/2333000/Silver_Pines/

*Official website* - https://www.silverpinesgame.com/
*Follow on Twitter* - https://twitter.com/SilverPinesGame
*Follow on TikTok* - https://www.tiktok.com/@silverpinesgame
*Follow on Instagram* - https://www.instagram.com/silverpinesgame/

#silverpines

*About Team17:*
Founded in 1990, Team17 is a leading developer, video games label, and creative partner for developers around the world. Team17’s portfolio of multi-award-winning and award-nominated in-house brands include Hell Let Loose, Golf With Your Friends, The Escapists, and the iconic Worms franchise, alongside its games label partner titles, including the award-winning games Blasphemous, DREDGE and Overcooked! franchise. Visit https://www.team17.com/ for more information.
